labels: A collared school shirt has pointed collar leaves, a vertical button placket and cuffed sleeves belonging to the same shirt body.; 깃 달린 교복 셔츠의 뾰족한 깃잎과 세로 단추 앞단, 커프스 소매가 같은 셔츠 몸판에 이어진다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: A collared school shirt has pointed collar leaves, a vertical button placket and cuffed sleeves belonging to the same shirt body.
